Disappointment wisdom ka nurse hai.
"Knockdown matter nahi—matter karta: uthte ho ya nahi."
Apna passion dhoondho.
Cheezon ko dekhne ka tarika badlo, cheezein khud badal jaayengi.
Shuruaat karne ka tareeqa hai ki baatein band karein aur kaam karna shuru karein.
"Main failure accept karta—sab kisi na kisi pe fail hote."
"Goals bina dreams, bas wishes."
Soch badlo, life badlo.
"Time waste nahi. Wise jiyo, great bano."
"Tum kya karte ho itna loud bolta—kehna sunai nahi deta."
"Kal ko realize karne ki limit—aj ke doubts."
